title: Menstrual Stigma and Human Capital: Experimental Evidence from Madagascar
title_zh: 月经污名与人力资本：来自马达加斯加的实验证据
title_primary: 月经污名与人力资本：来自马达加斯加的实验证据
title_secondary: Menstrual Stigma and Human Capital: Experimental Evidence from Madagascar
authors: Karen Macours, Julieta Vera Rueda, Duncan Webb
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Menstrual stigma affects adolescent girls worldwide, yet its impact on human capital development remains largely unexamined. We use a field experiment in 140 schools in Madagascar to evaluate interventions designed to reduce menstrual stigma and promote hygiene behaviors (N =2,250). Teacher-led sensitization on stigma and hygiene, menstrual products, and sanitation infrastructure together substantially improve girls' learning outcomes on standardized tests (+0.2 SD). These gains do not operate by improving school attendance or health, the channels typically invoked to justify menstrual hygiene programs. Instead, the improvements appear to arise from psychosocial mechanisms, including reduced menstrual stigma (measured using lab-in-the-field exercises, enumerator observations, and self-reports) and reduced stress (lower heart rate). We also test a novel approach for norm change by identifying "positive deviants"-girls within schools willing to openly challenge menstrual stigma. Selecting and training these positive deviants to serve as peer ambassadors for norm change produces significant additional improvements in self-reported stigma and hygiene behavior. The results demonstrate that addressing gender-specific psychosocial barriers can substantially improve girls' education outcomes in highly deprived contexts, while highlighting both the promise and limitations of leveraging positive deviance for social norm change.
abstract_zh: 月经污名影响着全球青春期女孩，但其对人力资本发展的影响在很大程度上尚未被研究。我们在马达加斯加的140所学校进行了一项实地实验，评估旨在减少月经污名并促进卫生行为的干预措施（样本量N=2,250）。由教师主导的关于污名与卫生的宣传教育、月经用品及卫生设施共同显著提高了女孩在标准化测试中的学习成果（+0.2标准差）。这些收益并非通过改善学校出勤率或健康来实现，而这两者通常是论证月经卫生项目合理性的渠道。相反，这些改善似乎源于心理社会机制，包括减少月经污名（通过实地实验室练习、调查员观察和自我报告测量）以及降低压力（心率降低）。我们还测试了一种新颖的规范变革方法，通过识别学校内愿意公开挑战月经污名的“积极偏差者”——即那些女孩。选拔并培训这些积极偏差者作为同伴大使推动规范变革，在自我报告的污名和卫生行为方面产生了显著的额外改善。结果表明，在高度贫困的环境中，解决性别特定的心理社会障碍可以显著提升女孩的教育成果，同时凸显了利用积极偏差促进社会规范变革的潜力与局限。

title: Rising Income Risk at the Top
title_zh: 顶层收入风险的上升
title_primary: 顶层收入风险的上升
title_secondary: Rising Income Risk at the Top
authors: J. Carter Braxton, Kyle F. Herkenhoff, Chengdai Huang, Michael Nattinger, Jonathan L. Rothbaum 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document an increase in U.S. income risk from 1969 to 2019 using newly digitized IRS tax returns, distinguishing permanent from transitory risk. Since the 1970s, permanent income risk increased across the distribution, but most sharply among high earners, rising nearly 70% among the top 5%. We show that, even among top earners, large negative income shocks strongly predict financial distress and higher income risk is linked with higher savings. In a quantitative life-cycle model, rising income risk concentrated at the top lowers the risk-free rate by 0.7pp, increases wealth inequality, and contributes to the "savings glut of the rich."
abstract_zh: 我们利用新近数字化的美国国税局纳税申报数据，记录了1969年至2019年间美国收入风险的上升情况，并区分了永久性与暂时性风险。自1970年代以来，永久性收入风险在各收入阶层中均有所增加，但在高收入群体中尤为显著，其中前5%人群的风险上升了近70%。我们表明，即使在最高收入者中，大规模负面收入冲击也能强烈预测财务困境，且更高的收入风险与更高的储蓄相关联。在一个定量生命周期模型中，集中于顶层的收入风险上升使无风险利率降低了0.7个百分点，加剧了财富不平等，并促成了“富人储蓄过剩”现象。

title: Window-dressing in environmental regulation: Short-term incentives and temporary abatement
title_zh: 环境规制中的粉饰行为：短期激励与临时减排
title_primary: 环境规制中的粉饰行为：短期激励与临时减排
title_secondary: Window-dressing in environmental regulation: Short-term incentives and temporary abatement
authors: Zhengwen Liu, Hong Ma, Fangrui Zhang
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how short-term political incentives affect firms’ compliance with environmental regulation. In China, city mayors face a sharp drop in promotion probability after age 57, creating a transitory enforcement window. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that firms governed by promotion-eligible mayors reduce sulfur dioxide ( S O 2 ) emissions substantially more than under the same mayors after the threshold. These reductions are concentrated among firms without end-of-pipe abatement equipment and are driven by temporary cuts in operating hours and output rather than technological upgrades. We further document that government subsidies increase during the promotion window and are disproportionately directed to unequipped firms that curtail production, consistent with coordinated short-run compliance. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that these transitory incentives account for 5.2% of the national S O 2 decline during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, but at a cost of 0.9% of total industrial output. We develop a dynamic model of firm compliance showing that such short-lived incentives induce inefficient output-based responses. Our findings highlight the limits of episodic regulatory pressure.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了短期政治激励如何影响企业遵守环境法规的情况。在中国，城市市长在57岁之后晋升概率急剧下降，这形成了一个短暂的执法窗口期。利用断点回归设计，我们发现，由具备晋升资格的市长管辖的企业，其二氧化硫排放量的减少幅度显著大于同一市长在超过年龄门槛后的时期。这些减排效果主要集中在没有末端治理设备的企业中，并且是通过临时减少运营时间和产量实现的，而非技术升级。我们进一步记录到，在晋升窗口期内政府补贴有所增加，并且不成比例地流向那些削减生产的无设备企业，这与协调一致的短期合规行为相符。粗略估算表明，这些暂时性激励措施在“十一五”规划期间贡献了全国二氧化硫减排量的5.2%，但代价是工业总产出减少了0.9%。我们构建了一个企业合规的动态模型，显示此类短期激励会导致低效的基于产出的应对行为。我们的研究结果凸显了阶段性监管压力的局限性。

title: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal
title_zh: 共担重负：葡萄牙药剂行业改革对药剂师劳动力市场的影响
title_primary: 共担重负：葡萄牙药剂行业改革对药剂师劳动力市场的影响
title_secondary: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal
authors: Card, David, Cardoso, Ana Rute, Silva, Pedro
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: During the 2010 financial crisis, the Portuguese government enacted a series of reforms in its prescription drug reimbursement system. Over the next three years, value added per pharmacist in retail pharmacies fell by a third, reflecting a rise in generic substitution and reductions in the markups allowed for prescription drugs. This massive shock led to pay cuts for incumbent pharmacists and the introduction of a two-tier pay system for new hires, with little or no reduction in the growth of employment. We use detailed longitudinal records from the Quadros de Pessoal database, merged with collective bargaining settlements and firms
abstract_zh: 在2010年金融危机期间，葡萄牙政府对其处方药报销制度实施了一系列改革。随后的三年里，零售药店中每位药剂师的人均附加值下降了三分之一，这反映了仿制药替代率的上升及处方药允许加成率的降低。这一巨大冲击导致在职药剂师薪酬削减，并为新入职者引入了两级薪酬体系，而就业增长几乎没有或完全没有放缓。我们利用来自“Quadros de Pessoal”数据库的详细纵向记录，结合集体谈判协议及企业层面的数据进行分析。

title: Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing Artificial Intelligence into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship
title_zh: 以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持高质量学术研究
title_primary: 以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持高质量学术研究
title_secondary: Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing Artificial Intelligence into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship
authors: Hemant K. Bhargava, Sarah H. Bana, Zhe Zhang, Laura Brandimarte, Vidyanand Choudhary 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by authors has accelerated production of academic articles and increased submission rates to journals, thereby straining review capacity and hurting journal outcome metrics, such as turnaround time and decision accuracy. Academic journals face an imperative to improve review quality and productivity by incorporating generative AI tools in the review workflow. As a concrete first step toward this idea, we outline a particular workflow that deploys large language models as a structured, trained, frontline reviewer. The workflow underlines that AI-produced evaluations must be transparent and contestable by authors. We emphasize the need for AI-infused peer review to be journal specific, designed for efficiency, accuracy, and accountability, within a human-in-the-loop oversight framework. We build a mathematical model of journal operations to compare outcomes under a status quo no-AI workflow and the proposed AI-infused workflow. The model captures how governed AI reconfigures human reviewer effort and illuminates conditions under which the AI-infused workflow can improve vital metrics, such as turnaround time and decision accuracy. Our essential point is that journals need to adopt a deliberate and institutionally governed approach for using AI in the review process. We recognize that identifying an “optimal” AI-infused peer review workflow or even definitively projecting the consequences of one will require substantial experimentation to calibrate and configure the workflow across multiple alternative designs. This discussion was accepted by Christoph Loch. Funding: D. Zantedeschi acknowledges support for this research from the Muma College of Business Dean’s Research Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2026.00184 .
abstract_zh: 作者采用人工智能（AI）加速了学术论文的生产，提高了期刊投稿率，从而对审稿能力造成压力，并损害了期刊的成果指标，如周转时间和决策准确性。学术期刊面临迫切需求，通过将生成式AI工具整合进审稿流程中，以提升审稿质量和效率。作为实现这一构想的具体第一步，我们概述了一种特定工作流程，该流程部署大型语言模型作为结构化、经过训练的前线审稿人。该工作流程强调，AI生成的评价必须对作者透明且可质疑。我们强调，AI辅助的同行评审需针对期刊特定设计，旨在实现效率、准确性和问责制，并在人机协同监督框架内运作。我们构建了一个期刊运营的数学模型，以比较现状无AI工作流程与所提出的AI融合工作流程下的结果。该模型捕捉了受治理的AI如何重新配置人类审稿人的努力，并阐明了AI融合工作流程在何种条件下能改善关键指标，如周转时间和决策准确性。我们的核心观点是，期刊需要在审稿过程中采用一种审慎且机构治理的方法来使用AI。我们认识到，确定“最优”的AI融合同行评审工作流程，甚至明确预测其后果，都需要大量实验来校准和配置多种替代设计下的工作流程。本讨论由Christoph Loch接受。资助：D. Zantedeschi感谢Muma商学院院长研究基金对本研究的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2026.00184获取。

title: How do capital tax incentives affect carbon productivity? Evidence from China’s VAT reform
title_zh: 资本税收激励如何影响碳生产率？来自中国增值税改革的证据
title_primary: 资本税收激励如何影响碳生产率？来自中国增值税改革的证据
title_secondary: How do capital tax incentives affect carbon productivity? Evidence from China’s VAT reform
authors: Shuai Wang, Tiantian Yang, Xuanxuan Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: China launched a pilot value-added tax reform in 2004 that allowed eligible firms to deduct input VAT on purchases of fixed assets, thereby lowering the user cost of capital. Using firm-level panel data from 2001 to 2008 and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the reform increased treated firms’ carbon productivity by approximately 28%. The effect emerged gradually and peaked in 2006. Mechanism eviden.ce suggests that the improvement was more closely associated with higher R&D investment and gains in total factor productivity than with simple input expansion. The results suggest that general-purpose investment policies can deliver climate co-benefits by promoting innovation and resource efficiency, even without explicit environmental objectives.
abstract_zh: 中国于2004年启动了增值税改革试点，允许符合条件的企业在购置固定资产时抵扣进项增值税，从而降低了资本使用成本。利用2001年至2008年的企业层面面板数据及双重差分设计，我们发现该改革使受处理企业的碳生产率提高了约28%。这一效应逐步显现，并于2006年达到峰值。机制证据表明，这一改善与研发投入增加及全要素生产率提升的关联更为紧密，而非简单的投入扩张。研究结果表明，即使没有明确的环境目标，通用型投资政策也能通过促进创新和资源效率，带来气候协同效益。

title: DP15104 Information, Market Power and Price Volatility
title_zh: 信息、市场势力与价格波动
title_primary: 信息、市场势力与价格波动
title_secondary: DP15104 Information, Market Power and Price Volatility
authors: Dirk Bergemann, Tibor Heumann, Stephen Morris
official: 官方在线 2020-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We consider demand function competition with a finite number of agents and private information. We show that any degree of market power can arise in the unique equilibrium under an information structure that is arbitrarily close to complete information. Regardless of the number of agents and the correlation of payo¤ shocks, market power may be arbitrarily close to zero (the competitive outcome) or arbitrarily large (so there is no trade). By contrast, price volatility is always lower than the variance of the aggregate shock across all information structures. Alternative trading mechanisms lead to very distinct bounds as a comparison with Cournot competition establishes.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑在有限数量代理人及私人信息条件下的需求函数竞争。我们证明，在任意接近完全信息的信息结构下，唯一均衡中可出现任意程度的市场势力。无论代理人数量多少以及收益冲击的相关性如何，市场势力可能任意接近于零（竞争性结果），也可能任意大（以至于无交易发生）。相比之下，价格波动性在所有信息结构下始终低于总冲击的方差。与古诺竞争的比较表明，不同的交易机制会导致截然不同的界限。

title: A Flexible Approach to Augmenting a Bayesian VAR with Nonlinear Factors *
title_zh: 一种增强贝叶斯向量自回归模型非线性因子的灵活方法
title_primary: 一种增强贝叶斯向量自回归模型非线性因子的灵活方法
title_secondary: A Flexible Approach to Augmenting a Bayesian VAR with Nonlinear Factors *
authors: Todd E. Clark, Florian Huber, Gary Koop
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a vector autoregression augmented with nonlinear factors that are modeled nonparametrically using regression trees. There are four main advantages of our model. First, modeling potential nonlinearities nonparametrically lessens the risk of misspecification. Second, the use of factor methods ensures that departures from linearity are modeled parsimoniously. In particular, they exhibit functional pooling where a small number of nonlinear factors are used to model common nonlinearities across variables. Third, Bayesian computation using MCMC is straightforward even in very high-dimensional models, allowing for efficient, equation-by-equation estimation, thus avoiding computational bottlenecks that arise in popular alternatives such as the time-varying parameter VAR. Fourth, existing methods for identifying structural economic shocks in linear factor models can be adapted for the nonlinear case in a straightforward fashion using our model. Exercises involving artificial and macroeconomic data illustrate the properties of our model and its usefulness for forecasting and structural economic analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种向量自回归模型，该模型通过回归树非参数化地引入了非线性因子。我们的模型有四大优势。第一，非参数化地建模潜在的非线性关系降低了模型设定错误的风险。第二，采用因子方法确保了非线性偏离被简约地建模。特别是，它们展现出功能汇集特性，即用少量非线性因子来刻画变量间共有的非线性特征。第三，即使在极高维模型中，利用MCMC的贝叶斯计算方法也直接可行，允许逐方程高效估计，从而避免了如时变参数VAR等流行替代方法中出现的计算瓶颈。第四，现有的线性因子模型中识别结构性经济冲击的方法，可以借助我们的模型直接适用于非线性情形。基于人工数据与宏观经济数据的实证分析展示了我们模型的性质及其在预测和结构性经济分析中的实用性。

title: Belief Disagreement, Instability, and Uncertainty under Stochastic Recall
title_zh: 随机回忆下的信念分歧、不稳定与不确定性
title_primary: 随机回忆下的信念分歧、不稳定与不确定性
title_secondary: Belief Disagreement, Instability, and Uncertainty under Stochastic Recall
authors: Pei Kuang, Li Tang, Michael Weber
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Expectations are typically modeled as functions of an agent’s information set. Using preregistered evidence, we show that beliefs depend instead on the information agents retrieve when forming them. Even after observing identical histories of inflation or stock returns, individuals recall different observations, and their beliefs track what they retrieve. Selective recall therefore generates disagreement, within-person belief instability, and heterogeneity in subjective uncertainty without any new information. We formalize these patterns in a parsimonious model in which agents store observed signals, retrieve each only probabilistically, and update optimally using recalled rather than objectively available information. The model yields sharp predictions for how beliefs vary with the composition of stored information, recall probabilities, and contextual cues. Large-scale experiments that hold information fixed and intervene only after exposure confirm these predictions, while survey evidence on macroeconomic and financial expectations supports their external relevance. Disagreement, instability, and uncertainty are thus structural features of belief formation rather than mere measurement error.
abstract_zh: 预期通常被建模为个体信息集的函数。基于预注册实验证据，我们发现信念实际上取决于个体在形成预期时所提取的信息。即便观察完全相同的通胀或股票回报历史序列，不同个体回忆起的观测值也存在差异，而他们的信念恰恰与所回忆的内容保持一致。因此，选择性记忆会在无任何新信息输入的情况下，引发个体间信念分歧、个体内信念波动以及主观不确定性的异质性。我们通过一个简约模型将这些规律形式化：在该模型中，个体存储观测信号，仅以概率方式提取每个信号，并基于回忆信息（而非客观可用信息）进行最优更新。该模型对信念如何随存储信息构成、回忆概率及情境线索变化提供了精准预测。在固定信息集且仅在信息暴露后实施干预的大规模实验中，这些预测得到验证；而关于宏观经济与金融预期的调查证据则支持其外部有效性。由此表明，分歧、波动与不确定性是信念形成的结构性特征，而非单纯的测量误差。

title: The two clocks of systemic importance
title_zh: 系统重要性的两个时钟
title_primary: 系统重要性的两个时钟
title_secondary: The two clocks of systemic importance
authors: Konstantinos Tolikas
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Systemic importance has two dimensions, a bank’s contribution to system-wide tail risk ($\Delta$CoVaR) and its exposure to it (marginal expected shortfall, MES). Using daily $\Delta$CoVaR and MES for 24 publicly traded Global Systemically Important Banks over 2012–2025, we show the two rankings move on different clocks. Contribution rankings reorder at the same rate in calm times, the pandemic, and after. Exposure rankings survive the pandemic but re-anchor sharply at the 2022–2023 interest-rate regime change, as euro-area banks fall and US and Japanese banks rise. Shocks rotate which banks contribute to systemic risk; only regime changes move which are exposed.
abstract_zh: 系统重要性具有两个维度：银行对系统性尾部风险的贡献度（$\Delta$CoVaR）及其风险暴露程度（边际预期损失，MES）。基于2012-2025年间24家上市全球系统重要性银行的日度$\Delta$CoVaR与MES数据，我们发现两种排名遵循不同的时间节奏。贡献度排名在平稳时期、疫情期间及疫情后均以相同速率重新排序；而风险暴露排名虽经受住疫情冲击，却在2022-2023年利率制度转换时发生剧烈锚定调整——欧元区银行排名下降，美日银行排名上升。冲击会改变哪些银行构成系统性风险贡献者，唯有制度变迁才能改变哪些银行面临风险暴露。

title: Time Is Not Money: An Experiment with Community Contribution Requirements in Cash and Labour
title_zh: 时间不是金钱：现金与劳动社区贡献要求的实验研究
title_primary: 时间不是金钱：现金与劳动社区贡献要求的实验研究
title_secondary: Time Is Not Money: An Experiment with Community Contribution Requirements in Cash and Labour
authors: Cocciolo, Serena, Ghisolfi, Selene, Habib, Ahasan, Tompsett, Anna
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Community contribution requirements are a ubiquitous but un- derstudied feature of projects to provide local public goods in de- veloping countries. A randomized experiment in rural Bangladesh shows that cash contribution requirements strongly reduce take-up and impact of safe drinking water infrastructure projects, compared to a contribution waiver. Labour contribution requirements do not, despite having similar value when priced at the market wage, be- cause most households value their time below the market wage and because labour contributions appear less costly to coordinate. Nei- ther contribution requirement increases cost-effectiveness once we account for coordination and monitoring costs, undermining a cen- tral rationale for their imposition.
abstract_zh: 社区贡献要求是发展中国家地方公共品项目中普遍存在但研究不足的特征。在孟加拉国农村地区开展的一项随机实验表明，与免除贡献要求相比，现金贡献要求显著降低了安全饮用水基础设施项目的参与率和影响效果。而劳动贡献要求并未产生类似影响——尽管按市场工资计价时其价值与现金贡献相当——这是因为大多数家庭对其时间的估值低于市场工资，且劳动贡献的协调成本似乎更低。在考虑协调与监督成本后，两种贡献要求均未提升成本效益，这动摇了实施此类要求的核心依据。

title: Paying for parity: Incentivizing men in feminized occupations
title_zh: 为平等买单：激励女性化职业中的男性
title_primary: 为平等买单：激励女性化职业中的男性
title_secondary: Paying for parity: Incentivizing men in feminized occupations
authors: Lucía Cobreros, Carlos Sunyer, Judit Vall Castelló
official: 来源期次 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We find that gender-neutral financial incentives increased the share of male General Practice (GP) residents by 30% in Catalonia, Spain. Exploiting a salary supplement policy for GP residents and a synthetic difference-in-differences design, we estimate an increase of 8.3 percentage points, with effects concentrated in areas receiving larger wage increases. We also document suggestive evidence of lower GP vacancy rates in treated regions after the policy, although this pattern cannot be interpreted causally. To our knowledge, these results provide the first causal evidence that gender-neutral financial incentives can attract men into a highly feminized occupation.
abstract_zh: 我们发现，性别中立的财政激励措施使西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区男性全科医生（GP）住院医师的比例增加了30%。利用针对全科住院医师的薪资补充政策及合成双重差分设计，我们估计这一比例上升了8.3个百分点，且效应集中在工资增幅较大的地区。我们还记录了政策实施后处理地区全科医生职位空缺率降低的提示性证据，尽管这一模式不能作因果解释。据我们所知，这些结果首次提供了因果证据，表明性别中立的财政激励能够吸引男性进入高度女性化的职业。

title: A Practitioner's Guide to Using Large Language Models and Generative AI in Economic History
title_zh: 经济学史中大型语言模型与生成式AI应用实践指南
title_primary: 经济学史中大型语言模型与生成式AI应用实践指南
title_secondary: A Practitioner's Guide to Using Large Language Models and Generative AI in Economic History
authors: Andreas Ferrara
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are lowering the entry barriers to working with exciting data sources that used to require strong data science skills, such as handwritten ledgers, text, images, or sound recordings. This guide provides an introduction for researchers who are new to LLMs. It sets out a step-by-step workflow for turning a research idea into working code and data, and describes the four main ways of interacting with an LLM: the chat window, editor-integrated assistants, agentic coding tools, and the API. It then works through the decisions a practitioner meets in sequence, beginning with whether an LLM is the right tool and whether the data are allowed to be sent to one, then how to select models, write prompts, manage context limits, and control costs, and finally how to validate, reproduce, document, and correct LLM-generated measures in regression settings. A review of recent research shows how these tools already extract, link, harmonize, and classify historical data at scale. Four worked examples with replication files illustrate the use of LLMs. They classify emotions in paintings, link census records without names, measure newspaper salience and sentiment around the 1882 Chinese Exclusion Act, and score the emotional delivery of Franklin D. Roosevelt's wartime speeches. The guide also condenses the workflow, the best-practice recommendations, and the preparation of replication packages into summary tables and checklists to aid applied economists.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在降低处理以往需要较强数据科学技能（如手写账本、文本、图像或录音）的优质数据源的准入门槛。本指南为初涉LLM的研究者提供入门指导，系统阐述了将研究构想转化为可运行代码与数据的逐步工作流程，并介绍了与LLM交互的四种主要方式：聊天窗口、编辑器集成助手、自主编码工具及应用程序编程接口（API）。随后，指南按序梳理实践者需应对的决策环节：首先判断LLM是否为合适工具及数据是否允许传输至模型，继而探讨模型选择、提示词编写、上下文限制管理及成本控制策略，最后阐述如何在回归分析场景中验证、复现、记录并修正LLM生成的度量指标。近期研究综述表明，这些工具已能大规模实现历史数据的提取、关联、整合与分类。四个附有复现文件的实操案例展示了LLM的应用场景：对画作中的情感进行分类、无姓名关联人口普查记录、测量1882年《排华法案》相关报纸的显著性与情感倾向，以及评估富兰克林·D·罗斯福战时演讲的情感表达。本指南还将工作流程、最佳实践建议及复现包准备要点凝练为汇总表格与核查清单，以辅助应用经济学研究者。

title: Are elites meritocratic and efficiency-seeking? Evidence from MBA students
title_zh: 精英是否追求贤能治理与效率？来自MBA学生的证据
title_primary: 精英是否追求贤能治理与效率？来自MBA学生的证据
title_secondary: Are elites meritocratic and efficiency-seeking? Evidence from MBA students
authors: Marcel Preuss, Germán Reyes, Jason Somerville, Joy Wu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Elites disproportionately influence policymaking, yet little is known about their fairness and efficiency preferences—key determinants of support for redistributive policies. We investigate these preferences in an incentivized lab experiment with future elites: Ivy League MBA students. We find that MBA students implement substantially more unequal earnings distributions than the average American, regardless of whether inequality stems from luck or merit. Their redistributive choices are also far more responsive to efficiency costs than the near-zero response found in representative U.S. samples. These patterns partly reflect distinct fairness ideals: a large share of MBA students falls outside standard classifications, instead displaying “weak meritocratic” tendencies that tolerate inequality even when it stems from luck. These findings identify a channel through which elite preferences may sustain U.S. inequality.
abstract_zh: 精英阶层对政策制定的影响不成比例地巨大，然而关于他们的公平与效率偏好——这些是支持再分配政策的关键决定因素——我们知之甚少。我们通过一项带有激励机制的实验室实验，以未来精英——常春藤联盟MBA学生为对象，探究了这些偏好。研究发现，MBA学生实施的收入分配不平等程度显著高于普通美国人，无论这种不平等源于运气还是能力。他们的再分配选择对效率成本的响应也远高于美国代表性样本中近乎为零的响应。这些模式部分反映了不同的公平理念：相当大比例的MBA学生不属于标准分类，而是表现出“弱精英主义”倾向，即使不平等源于运气也予以容忍。这些发现揭示了精英偏好可能维持美国不平等的一个渠道。

title: Policy Distorion in Credit Allocation: Evidence from an Economic Stimulus
title_zh: 信贷配置中的政策扭曲：来自经济刺激计划的证据
title_primary: 信贷配置中的政策扭曲：来自经济刺激计划的证据
title_secondary: Policy Distorion in Credit Allocation: Evidence from an Economic Stimulus
authors: Ho, Chun-Yu, Li, Dan, Tian, Shut, Zhu, Xiaodong
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines how bank behavior contributes to capital misallocation from the supply side, leveraging China's 2008 fiscal stimulus as a quasi-experimental setting. Using proprietary loan-level data from a major state-owned bank, we document systematic credit misallocation favoring state-owned enterprises (SOEs) over private firms. Following the stimulus announcement, the bank reduced interest rates significantly more for SOEs than for comparable private enterprises-a differential reduction of 0.36 standard deviations-despite SOEs exhibiting higher default rates and unchanged credit ratings. We identify the mechanism as a loosening of risk-based pricing: interest rates became less sensitive to internal credit ratings for SOEs. This risk-based pricing misallocation largely relates to the industrial policy in supporting government-preferred industries. Notably, no such distortion appears in bankers' acceptances, a less-regulated shadow banking activity, suggesting policy intervention-not financial frictions-drives the observed misallocation. Our findings provide direct micro-level evidence on how government directives and industrial policy induce capital misallocation through weakened credit risk management in state-owned banks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国2008年财政刺激政策作为准自然实验，从供给侧探讨银行行为如何导致资本错配。基于一家大型国有银行的专有贷款数据，我们记录了系统性信贷错配现象，即信贷资源偏向国有企业而非私营企业。在刺激政策宣布后，该银行对国有企业的利率下调幅度显著大于可比私营企业——差异达0.36个标准差——尽管国有企业违约率更高且信用评级未变。我们识别出的机制是风险定价的放松：国有企业的利率对内部信用评级的敏感度下降。这种风险定价错配在很大程度上与支持政府偏好产业的产业政策相关。值得注意的是，在银行承兑汇票（一种监管较少的影子银行活动）中并未出现此类扭曲，这表明政策干预而非金融摩擦驱动了所观察到的错配现象。我们的研究为政府指令和产业政策如何通过削弱国有银行信用风险管理而导致资本错配提供了直接的微观层面证据。

title: Population Ageing and the Environment: A Comparative Study of Nature-Concerning and Action-Requiring Outcomes
title_zh: 人口老龄化与环境：自然关注型与行动需求型结果的比较研究
title_primary: 人口老龄化与环境：自然关注型与行动需求型结果的比较研究
title_secondary: Population Ageing and the Environment: A Comparative Study of Nature-Concerning and Action-Requiring Outcomes
authors: Andreas Irmen, Maria Krelifa, Anastasia Litina
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines an under-explored implication of population ageing: its relationship with environmental outcomes at the country level and environmental attitudes at the individual level. The analysis introduces a novel classification of environmental outcomes, distinguishing between action-requiring and nature-concerning dimensions based on the degree of civic engagement necessary for their realisation. Using panel data from a broad set of countries over the period 1995–2018, population ageing is shown to be associated with improvements in environmental outcomes that require limited civic engagement, while no systematic relationship is observed for outcomes that rely on active public participation. Complementary evidence from individual-level survey data for 2005–2016 indicates that ageing societies exhibit lower levels of environmental engagement, without a corresponding decline in underlying environmental concern. The findings contribute to the literature on demographic change and environmental performance by highlighting the role of civic engagement as a mediating mechanism and suggest that ageing societies may face specific challenges in sustaining participatory forms of environmental action.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人口老龄化一个尚未充分挖掘的影响：其在国家层面与环境结果、个体层面与环境态度之间的关系。分析引入了一种新的环境结果分类方法，根据实现这些结果所需的公民参与程度，将其区分为“需要行动型”和“关注自然型”两个维度。利用1995–2018年间多个国家的面板数据，研究发现人口老龄化与那些需要有限公民参与的环境结果的改善相关，而对于依赖公众积极参与的环境结果，则未观察到系统性关联。基于2005–2016年个体层面调查数据的补充证据表明，老龄化社会中的环境参与水平较低，但潜在的环境关注并未相应下降。这些发现通过强调公民参与作为中介机制的作用，为人口变化与环境绩效的相关文献做出了贡献，并表明老龄化社会在维持参与式环境行动方面可能面临特定挑战。

title: Discounted Subjective Expected Utility in continuous time
title_zh: 连续时间下的折现主观期望效用
title_primary: 连续时间下的折现主观期望效用
title_secondary: Discounted Subjective Expected Utility in continuous time
authors: Lorenzo Bastianello, Vassili Vergopoulos
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: By embedding uncertainty into time, we obtain a conjoint axiomatic characterization of both Exponential Discounting and Subjective Expected Utility that accommodates arbitrary state and outcome spaces. In doing so, we provide a novel and simple time-interpretation of subjective probability. The subjective probability of an event is calibrated using time discounting.
abstract_zh: 通过将不确定性嵌入时间之中，我们获得了指数贴现与主观期望效用的一种联合公理化刻画，该刻画适用于任意状态空间和结果空间。在此过程中，我们为主观概率提供了一种新颖且简洁的时间解释。事件的主观概率通过时间贴现进行校准。

title: Fundamentally Reforming the DI System: Evidence from Germany
title_zh: 从根本上改革伤残保险体系：来自德国的证据
title_primary: 从根本上改革伤残保险体系：来自德国的证据
title_secondary: Fundamentally Reforming the DI System: Evidence from Germany
authors: Yaming Cao, Björn Fischer-Weckemann, Johannes Geyer, Nicolas Ziebarth
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In 2001, Germany abolished public occupational disability insurance (ODI)—the second tier of its public DI system—for cohorts born after 1960. Using administrative data, we first document that, in the long run, overall DI inflows declined by roughly one-third. Second, using representative survey data, we document at best modest ODI insurance take-up responses in the private individual, risk-rated market, which lacks guaranteed issue. Third, an equilibrium model incorporating interactions between the public safety net, the first-tier public DI, and the private market reveals that coverage denials and weak insurance demand, driven by complementary social insurance, can explain the modest private ODI take-up response. Coverage gradients by income and health are thus substantial. Finally, counterfactual simulations highlight the limited scope of incremental reforms.
abstract_zh: 2001年，德国废除了针对1960年后出生群体的公共职业伤残保险（ODI）——其公共伤残保险体系的第二层级。基于行政数据，我们首先发现，从长期来看，总体伤残保险流入量下降了约三分之一。其次，利用代表性调查数据，我们发现在缺乏保证承保条款的风险评级私人市场中，ODI保险的参保反应充其量仅为温和水平。第三，通过构建包含公共安全网、第一层级公共伤残保险与私人市场之间相互作用的均衡模型，我们发现：由补充性社会保险驱动的承保拒绝与疲弱的保险需求，可以解释私人ODI参保反应的温和特征。由此，按收入与健康水平划分的保障梯度差异显著。最后，反事实模拟凸显了渐进式改革的有限空间。

title: A dynamic state-space HAR model
title_zh: 动态状态空间HAR模型
title_primary: 动态状态空间HAR模型
title_secondary: A dynamic state-space HAR model
authors: Mike Tsionas, Aya Ghalayini, Marwan Izzeldin, Lorenzo Trapani
official: 官方在线 2025-11-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Heterogeneous AutoRegressive model for the logs of Realised Volatility (HARL) has established itself as the benchmark specification for modelling and forecasting return volatility, owing to its parsimony and ability to capture the strong persistence typically observed in RV. To address potential concerns such as measurement errors, nonlinearities, and non-spherical residuals, numerous variants of the baseline HARL model have been developed in the literature. This paper contributes to this body of work by proposing a new class of dynamic state-space models with time-varying parameters. The parameter dynamics are assumed to follow an autoregressive process, with or without stochastic volatility, giving rise to two specifications: SHARP and SHARP-SV. Both models are designed to capture the evolving nature of return volatility and are estimated via Bayesian inference using Particle Gibbs sampling. Empirical applications to high-frequency data on SPY, sector ETFs, representative NYSE stocks, and the VIX index demonstrate that our proposed models on average outperform alternative HARL-based specifications in forecasting volatility, particularly at medium- and long-term horizons. An extensive Monte Carlo analysis further illustrates the advantages of our approach in terms of both estimation accuracy and predictive performance.
abstract_zh: 基于已实现波动率（RV）对数的异质自回归模型（HARL）因其简洁性及捕捉RV中通常观察到的强持续性的能力，已成为建模和预测收益波动率的基准规范。为解决测量误差、非线性及非球形残差等潜在问题，文献中已发展出多种基线HARL模型的变体。本文通过提出一类具有时变参数的新动态状态空间模型，为该领域研究做出贡献。参数动态被假定遵循自回归过程，可包含或不包含随机波动性，由此产生两种规格：SHARP和SHARP-SV。两种模型均旨在捕捉收益波动率的演变特性，并通过使用粒子吉布斯抽样的贝叶斯推断进行估计。对SPY、行业ETF、代表性纽交所股票及VIX指数的高频数据实证应用表明，我们提出的模型在预测波动率方面平均优于其他基于HARL的规格，尤其是在中期和长期预测区间。广泛的蒙特卡洛分析进一步展示了我们方法在估计精度和预测性能方面的优势。
